summary.text: First of the leaders of the Danaans whom Hector slew when Zeus vouchsafed the prince glory in his rampage — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: Who then was first to be slain, and who last by Hector, Priam's son, when Zeus vouchsafed him glory? Asaeus first, and Autonous, and Opites and Dolops son of Clytius, and Opheltius, and Agelaus, and Aesymnus, and Orus, and Hipponous, staunch in fight. These leaders of the Danaans he slew and thereafter fell upon the multitude.
